newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish govt seeks authority to cut stake in IVO.
newsitem.headline: Finnish govt seeks authority to cut stake in IVO.

text.p: The Finnish government said in a statement on Tuesday it was seeking parliament's authorisation to lower the state's ownership in power group Imatran Voima Oy to below two-thirds.

"In the supplementary budget, the government is seeking parliament's authorisation for ownership arrangements by which the state can give up its two-thirds qualified majority position in Imatran Voima Oy, but still retain voting control in this company," the government said in a statement with its autumn 1996 supplementary budget.
